scope: Formal groupoid and implication audit. No physical gauge, global mode identity, or theorem of grammar adequacy is assumed.
needed_extra_bridge_for_NCC_derivation: GrammarAdequacy: every genuine intrinsic content is represented in the current finite grammar.
description_class_definition: isomorphism class under all transformations preserving the declared signature
boundary_status: Successor-connected components are graph-theoretically maximal once successor is stipulated; AP3L maximal contexts do not establish their genuine-mode status.
restricted_conclusion: The minimal signature still has one connected isomorphism description class, but NCC is not derived by essential closure alone and H_full is not literally Aut(M_f). The strongest accurate statement uses a connected groupoid of declared-structure isomorphisms and treats no-hidden-code as a minimal-semantic methodological rule unless a grammar-adequacy bridge is independently established.
